As a member of the HR team, you may be given other job duties to support the department unrelated HR Operations.
This position is on-site in Livermore, CA
and reports to the Director, HR Operations

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

Own and enhance core HR processes including employee lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding, compliance, and policy implementation
Ensure actions comply with company policies and procedures and to local, state, and federal employment law
Support managers and employees with transactions in SAP SuccessFactors while maintaining data integrity
Identify opportunities to streamline operations and implement scalable solutions that improve employee experience
Generate HR reports and provide operational insights to support decision-making
Prepare compliance reporting (EEO, ACA, state/federal audits)
Lead HR-related projects, such as process optimization, policy rollouts, or system enhancements in partnership with HRIS
Establish and enforce best practices regarding standard operating procedures (SOPs) for ticket resolution as well as operational workflows
Utilize and work within a case management tool (FreshServices) for handling and prioritizing requests to ensure SLA is achieved
Work cross-functionally with teams to collect documentation for legal and/or compliance related initiatives
Support HR systems releases, identify impact and enhancement opportunities associated with a new release, and communicate appropriately with key stakeholders
Develop processes to audit, analyze, resolve, and mitigate current and future issues
Other HR activities as needed within the HR department

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent experience required
Minimum 4 years of progressive experience in HR operations, HR analytics, or HR support
Strong knowledge of HR processes, compliance requirements, and data governance
Expertise with HR systems (HRIS platforms like SAP SuccessFactors; case/ticketing systems such as FreshServices).
Advanced experience in MS Office 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Advanced Excel, Visio, and SharePoint)
Solid knowledge of core HR processes, including onboarding/offboarding, position changes, benefits administration, payroll, and employee data integrity
Must have the ability to remain focused, professional, tactful, committed to confidentiality, and discrete when handling sensitive and/or confidential information
Excellent communication skills, consistent responsiveness and strong problem-resolution abilities (critical, strategic, and evaluative thinking)
Project Management experience preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Ability to lift 25 lbs.
Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, and occasionally kneel or squat
Prolonged periods of sitting/standing at a desk and working on a computer
The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation
No travel required
Standard start time: 6:30AM (negotiable)
Must be able to navigate manufacturing environment, comfortable around heavy machinery, tools, etc.
Must be able to wear Personal Protective Equipment, (i.e. safety glasses, bump caps, hearing protection, etc.)

EXPECTED COMPENSATION

$102,600 - $130,000/annual salary + premium benefits

Overview

Kelley Construction is a multi-faceted commercial and industrial general contractor licensed to perform work in many states across the United States. We offer a wealth of technical expertise in all areas of commercial construction including: restaurants, medical facilities, warehousing, fast food chains, large design-build expansions and general office renovation. We also have broad experience in industrial construction, from liquid storage and containment and petroleum related construction to… [more] pre-engineered metal buildings and concrete construction. Why Kelley

Kelley Construction is a diversified, family-owned contractor based in Louisville, Kentucky. We’ve been building since 1978 and are licensed in 49 states. Our Energy and Infrastructure (E&I) business unit is focused on civil and concrete work in energy and heavy industrial markets for oil, gas and chemical, industrial gases, power generation, renewables, and battery storage clients.

We self-perform earthwork and structural concrete, with a heavy emphasis on concrete . As a Senior Project Manager, you’ll direct Kelley’s own crews on elevated concrete foundations for storage tanks, heavy duty concrete paving (HDCP), and complex industrial facility concrete. Your role will also include managing subcontractors in various trades such as underground electrical and utilities, pre-engineered building construction, and others.

This is a remote position. You’ll manage projects across the country from home and travel to job sites under 20% of the time.

To provide Project Management and oversight of heavy industrial projects with focus on civil and concrete scopes. Activities include procurement, preparation of work plans, contract management, budget and schedule management, supervision of project teams, construction and other duties as assigned.

Develops a cost-effective plan and schedule for completion of projects
Oversees performance of all projects and timelines, including employees, contract trade workforce and any subcontractors
Oversees multiple projects up to and including 10M+ and/or of high complexity
Ensures compliance with drawings, specifications, and regulations.
Will be responsible for proper administration of construction contracts and purchase orders.
Responsible for ensuring full risk management, including the identification of potential risks and initiating treatments as appropriate.
Reviews and responds to any safety concerns and/or infractions, to ensure that they are corrected and reported in a timely manner
Tracks project schedule and ensures that projects stays within estimated timeline
Controls construction cost, deliveries and schedule to achieve completion of project within budget allocation
Manage the storage and organization of all project documents.
Communicates with owners about progress and any necessary modifications of plans
Must be able to work under pressure to meet deadlines.
Travel as needed for control on assigned projects (less than 20%).
Directs one or more Assistant Project Manager(s) / Project Engineer(s)
Builds relationships with subcontractors and business partners in the market.
Indirectly mentor Project Managers on effective resolution strategies.
Provide input on execution strategies and schedule sequencing for bids as needed.
Performs all other duties as assigned

Qualifications Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management or a related field, or equivalent combination fo education and experience.
8+ years industrial construction project management experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Energy, and/or Renewables.
Must have large project, multi-million dollar, construction experience.
Must be able to read and interpret engineered drawings, estimates, and work instructions.
Ability to develop and lead employees and contract workforce.
Possess a high-level of professionalism and confidentiality.
Proficient with MS Office, MS Project and/ or Primavera, Bluebeam, AutoCAD and Procore.
Ability to read, interpret and execute engineer drawings, specifications, and work instructions.

Ability to establish credibility and be decisive while recognizing and supporting the organization's preferences and priorities.

Take a hands-on approach with web and mobile (Android/iOS), test automation tools and frameworks, showcasing a proven ability to implement successful automated testing solutions. Drive QA automation and performance testing initiatives for software development projects, ensuring timely execution, defect tracking, and successful project delivery. Implement and manage robust web and mobile test automation frameworks using Java with Selenium/Appium and JavaScript with Cypress, driving test coverage and reducing regression effort. Design and executed comprehensive performance testing strategies utilizing JMeter and Gatling, ensuring scalability and responsiveness of critical applications. Coordinate project activities among QA engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to support collaborative project execution and delivery timelines. Develop test data setup scripts to support automated and manual test scenarios; integrated these scripts into automation pipelines to ensure consistent and reliable test validation. Coordinate QA activities and promote adherence to established testing standards, automation methodologies, and software development lifecycle processes. Plan, implement, and oversee QA automation and testing activities to support software development project objectives and release schedules. Integrate best practices for both manual and automated testing methodologies. Collaborate with multiple agile and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of QA processes. Identify and implement process improvements aimed at positively impacting product quality. Manage automation and performance testing projects, including scheduling, implementation, execution, monitoring, and reporting activities. Provide technical guidance regarding QA automation tools, testing frameworks, and project deliverables to support successful project implementation. Coordinate QA project assignments and testing activities across geographically distributed agile teams to ensure project milestones and deliverables are achieved. Oversee the creation and maintenance of comprehensive testing documentation. Provide regular status reports on QA activities, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement. Plan, coordinate, and implement automation and performance testing activities for enterprise software applications. Coordinate the development and execution of test plans, test cases, and automated test scripts to support software quality assurance objectives.

100% remote; must reside in U.S.; reports to HQ in Englewood, CO.

Bachelor's degree or a U.S. equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, plus 5 years of experience as an IT Manager, Information Systems Project Manager, or in any occupation, job title, or position developing and enhancing automation frameworks.

5 years of professional experience utilizing software QA methodologies, tools, and processes, including test automation tools and frameworks; 5 years of professional experience utilizing Java, JavaScript, Cypress, Selenium, Cucumber, JMeter, TestNG, and Jenkins; 5 years of professional experience utilizing software testing principles and methodologies; 5 years of professional experience working with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines; 5 years of professional experience utilizing Test Rail and JIRA for test planning and defect tracking; 5 years of professional experience performing API testing using Postman or REST Assured; 5 years of professional experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts using Java and JavaScript; 5 years of professional experience leading distributed Agile teams; and 3 years of professional experience utilizing Postgre SQL for backend data validation and testing.

Description

Are you passionate about bringing complex projects to life through thoughtful design, strong project leadership, and collaboration? Are you looking for a workplace that truly puts people first?

At HEAPY, we believe great work starts with a Colleague First
culture, one that supports growth, encourages development, and values flexibility. We are a forward-thinking engineering consulting firm committed to creating sustainable, healthy, and resilient environments while empowering our colleagues through meaningful work, strong relationships, and shared values.

HEAPY is seeking a Project Manager
to join our Healthcare practice, based out of our Greenville, SC office. In this role, you will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of healthcare engineering projects, guide multidisciplinary design teams, contribute to complex MEP design solutions, and ensure projects are delivered with exceptional quality, technical excellence, and client satisfaction.

The Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful execution of medium to large-scale healthcare engineering projects from initial planning and design through construction administration and project closeout. This role provides project leadership, oversees design coordination, manages project budgets and schedules, and ensures deliverables meet client expectations and HEAPY's standards for technical excellence.

Working closely with architects, owners, developers, construction managers, and internal engineering teams, the Project Manager facilitates collaboration across disciplines, resolves project challenges, and drives effective communication throughout the project lifecycle. This position also contributes to design development, reviews technical solutions, and provides guidance to project team members to support successful project outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of MEP engineering and design, project management, and the unique technical and operational requirements of healthcare environments. Success in this role is measured by effective project execution, design quality, financial performance, team collaboration, and client satisfaction.

Colleagues in this position are responsible for managing medium to large-sized projects with fees for services ranging from $500,000 to $750,000, often requiring coordination and support from multiple sectors.

Click here to learn more about HEAPY!

Qualifications

4-year degree (mechanical, electrical or plumbing preferred) or equivalent years of project management experience leading MEP/AEC teams in the Built Environment.
At least 8- 10 years of experience in design engineering, A/E, MEP, or commissioning consulting engineering and/or field construction (or equivalent working knowledge/experience).
Demonstrated experience independently managing multidisciplinary engineering projects involving mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and associated design disciplines, from proposal development through closeout.
Proven reputation for developing long-term relationships with architects, owners, developers, and corporate clients in a manner that leads to repeat business.
Strong understanding of the architectural design and construction process, including traditional design-bid-build, design-build, and fast-track project delivery.
Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
Experience in HVAC systems, central plants, building automation, energy efficiency, and building infrastructure in the healthcare sector preferred.

Key Responsibilities

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Guides HEAPY service delivery to ensure consistency with the appropriate service operating procedures and identified milestones.
Successfully leads multidisciplinary engineering projects from opportunity identification and proposal development through design, construction administration, and project closeout.
Oversees project execution with a strategic focus on profitability, ensuring efficient resource allocation, cost control, and streamlined workflows.
Serves as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for architects, owners, developers, construction managers, and corporate clients, fostering strong relationships that drive repeat business and long-term partnerships.
Manages multidisciplinary teams, including internal engineering staff and external consultants, ensuring effective project execution and resource allocation.
Develops project scopes, staffing plans, schedules, budgets, fees, and deliverables while ensuring alignment with client expectations and project objectives.
Independently leads the facilitation of project meetings, design reviews, client presentations, and stakeholder discussions while maintaining clear communication among all project participants and resolving technical and contractual issues.
Thoroughly understands client business objectives, translating them into actionable engineering project requirements.
Drives project quality by ensuring deliverables meet HEAPY standards, client expectations, and all regulatory requirements. This includes:
Proactively identifying and resolving issues, evaluating engineering design approaches, and identifying technical, coordination, and constructability risks.
Ensuring adherence to applicable building codes, energy codes, and industry standards
Reviewing engineering deliverables for completeness, coordination, and compliance with client expectations.
Ensuring technical engineering staff and external consultants maintain accuracy, consistency, and technical excellence.
Ensuring strong responsiveness, accountability, and follow-through on all aspects of the projects, leveraging superior communication skills.
Professionally and confidently manages difficult client situations while maintaining positive relationships and protecting HEAPY’s interests.

Identifies and pursues opportunities to initiate and introduce HEAPY service offerings within new accounts and across all verticals of the business.
Leverages newly established client relationships to open doors to new owners and expand connections within networks to continue to build business opportunities.
Pursues work through established relationships with architects, owners, developers, and/or construction managers, preferably within the Cleveland and broader Cleveland markets.
Collaborates with the Practice Director, Operations Manager, practice design managers, and project managers to evaluate opportunities and develop pursuit strategies; participates in client interviews, qualifications presentations, and project pursuits.
Represents HEAPY at industry events, professional organizations, networking functions, and client meetings to strengthen market presence and promote the firm's capabilities.
Provides leadership, mentorship, and guidance to project managers, engineers, and emerging professionals while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Maintains a strong understanding of MEP building systems, industry trends, and project delivery methods to effectively guide project teams and support client objectives.
Uses CRM and project management tools to maintain accurate project, client, and opportunity information and support business planning effort.
Proactively recognizes scope changes and proposes solutions for project risks and scope management/fee management issues.
Additional responsibilities as requested/needed.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

Ability to remain sedentary at a workstation for long periods of time while operating a keyboard and using a computer screen.
Ability to communicate in person and via phone with other individuals.
Possession of Reliable transportation to and from the project.
Ability to work in all elements of indoor and outdoor environments, which include heat, cold, rain, snow, wind, etc.
Ability to access all areas of the job site with activities that include ascending and descending stairs, scaffolding, ladders, navigating elevation changes, etc.
Capable of working in physical positions that may include maneuvering oneself into different positions traditionally achieved by kneeling, sitting, standing, squatting, bending over, etc.
Ability to move, transport, or position items weighing up to 25 lbs.
Ability to apply established protocols and practices in a timely manner and follow safety guidelines for both the company and clients.
Ability to gather, organize, and evaluate information related to projects and calculations (such as finances, timelines, etc.).
Ability to perform local travel (Ability to perform distant travel as needed (

Built for People, Not Just Projects – a collaborative, colleague-first culture where you can do your best work

Invest in Your Future – 401(k) with competitive contributions to help you plan ahead

GCP ist ein stabiles und finanz­starkes Immo­bilien­unter­nehmen mit Fokus auf Wohn­immobilien. Seit über einem Jahr­zehnt bewirt­schaften wir viele tausend Wohnungen im eigenen Bestand in allen Fach­bereichen der Wert­schöpfungs­kette. Gemäß unserem Leitsatz "Bei uns in guten Wänden" verbessern wir Wohnraum und Wohn­umfeld und sorgen dafür, dass guter, bezahl­barer Wohnraum geschaffen wird und erhalten bleibt. Program Leadership and Delivery

Provide overall leadership, direction, and day-to-day management for the EFAST2 contract, establishing priorities, execution strategies, governance, and performance expectations.

Assure the quality of products, services, and deliverables through quality management processes, reviews, audits, inspections, and site visits.
Establish and monitor performance metrics, provide transparent reporting, and implement corrective and continuous-improvement actions when needed.

Manage program budgets of comparable size and complexity, including forecasts, resource plans, financial reporting, and controls that maintain expenditures within the allotted contract ceiling.
Plan and monitor staffing and resource utilization to ensure the right technical, operational, and administrative capabilities are available to meet program needs.
Coordinate and monitor subcontractor, consultant, and vendor activities, performance, schedules, quality, and deliverables.
Ensure effective communication, integration, and accountability across all contract participants and external partners.

Education and Certifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or another field related to the contract requirements.
Project Management Institute Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
Project Management Institute Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) certification or equivalent.

Experience

At least 15 years of experience managing IT projects or programs of similar complexity and size.
At least 10 years of experience managing projects or programs with 30 or more personnel, including specialized subcontractors and consultants.
At least 10 years of experience collaborating with customers and stakeholders to understand and anticipate needs and translate them into product and program requirements.
At least 10 years of experience managing budgets of similar size and complexity while remaining within the allotted ceiling amount.
Demonstrated success managing, coordinating, and sustaining Federal IT programs of similar complexity and scale on schedule and within budget.
Demonstrated success organizing, planning, directing, and coordinating geographically dispersed systems development, operations, and contact center teams comprising 30 or more technical staff, subcontractors, and consultants.
Demonstrated success managing programs of similar complexity and size in a cloud-based environment.
Demonstrated success producing effective oral and written communications and presenting to all levels of Government management.
Demonstrated success interpreting and operationalizing Federal Government policies and requirements.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Expert knowledge of Federal IT program management, governance, acquisition, risk, quality, and compliance practices.
Executive-level leadership, organizational, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead large, geographically dispersed, multidisciplinary teams in a matrixed, mission-critical environment.
Ability to balance changing priorities while maintaining accountability for customer outcomes, quality, schedule, budget, and contract performance.
Strong command of Agile, hybrid Agile, and traditional delivery methodologies, with the judgment to apply the appropriate approach.

Te Tūranga | About the role

As our Enterprise Information Security Manager
, you’ll lead Tauranga City Council’s information security governance, risk, compliance and assurance function.

Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you’ll translate Council’s security strategy into a governed, measurable and auditable programme. You’ll lead the frameworks, policies, risk practices and independent assurance activities that give Council confidence its security controls are effective and its information assets are appropriately protected.

This Is An Influential Leadership Role Where You’ll

lead and develop Council’s information security governance, risk, compliance and assurance capability
maintain an effective security policy and governance framework aligned with recognised standards
oversee the identification, assessment, treatment and monitoring of information security risks
lead compliance with legislative, regulatory and contractual requirements, including PCI DSS
deliver a threat-based security assurance programme and oversee external auditors, assessors and specialist providers
provide clear, timely reporting on Council’s security posture, risks, compliance and assurance
strengthen incident readiness, resilience assurance and security-aware behaviours across the organisation
translate complex security matters into clear business impacts and priorities for senior leaders and governance groups.

You’ll work closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Audit and Risk Committee, Elected Members and leaders across Council. Your advice and reporting will support informed decisions about security risk, priorities and investment.

Ngā Pukenga | What you’ll need to succeed

To Succeed In This Role, You’ll Bring

a degree-level qualification in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, risk or a related discipline
at least eight years’ experience in information security, including three or more years in governance, risk, compliance or assurance
a recognised industry certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or CISA
strong working knowledge of NZISM, the Protective Security Requirements, ISO/IEC 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, PCI DSS and the Privacy Act 2020
experience applying security frameworks and regulatory requirements within a complex organisation
proven people leadership experience, including the ability to build team capability, resilience and performance
experience managing external auditors, assessors and specialist security providers
excellent report-writing, influencing and communication skills
the ability to translate technical security risks into clear advice for executive and non-technical audiences.

Experience in local government, central government or another complex and highly regulated environment will be important.

You’ll combine sound technical and regulatory knowledge with pragmatic leadership. You’ll be comfortable challenging constructively, building trusted relationships and helping decision-makers understand both the risk and the practical path forward.

Tō Tātou Kaunihera | About Tauranga City Council

At Tauranga City Council, our work helps shape one of New Zealand’s fastest-growing cities. From planning for growth and delivering critical infrastructure to creating great community outcomes, our people make a tangible difference every day.

This is an exciting time to join us. We’re investing in our future, embracing innovation and strengthening our organisation so we can continue delivering value for our community. As our Enterprise Information Security Manager, you’ll play an important role in that journey by strengthening the governance, risk, compliance and assurance practices that protect Council’s information, services and community outcomes.

Located in the beautiful Bay of Plenty, Tauranga offers the opportunity to do meaningful, high-impact work while enjoying an exceptional lifestyle. Whether you’re already here or considering relocating, you’ll find a vibrant city, a strong sense of community and outstanding access to beaches, outdoor recreation and family-friendly living.

We Offer

a senior security leadership role with visibility across executive and governance forums
the opportunity to shape Council’s enterprise security governance, risk and assurance capability
flexible and supportive ways of working
five weeks’ annual leave
ongoing learning, career and professional development opportunities
meaningful work that contributes directly to the future of our city and community.

If you’re collaborative, forward-thinking and community-minded, you’ll find meaningful work, talented colleagues and the opportunity to make a genuine difference here.

You can find out more about working at Tauranga City Council here.

To submit your application, please apply online, as we are unable to accept applications via email.

Applications will close on 14th December.

This role suits a supply chain professional who can read a complex data set and determine what to do about it: someone who turns supplier survey results into prioritized supplier, sourcing and engineering actions, and carries those actions to closure across a matrixed global organization.

Analytics & Reporting: Analyze large and complex supplier and product data sets using advanced analytics tools (Excel, Databricks, Tableau etc.) to identify exposure, risk and gaps. Develop the reporting that drives compliance and cost initiatives and informs sourcing decisions.

Regulatory Compliance: Serve as the Global Supply Chain point of contact for product and environmental regulatory requirements, including US-EPA/TSCA and EU/REACH, partnering with the Compliance Legal team on formal interpretation and with EHS as needed.
Project Management: Lead and manage multiple compliance projects and programs simultaneously, applying best-in-class methodologies to ensure successful delivery of outcomes, milestones and resource allocation.
Communication & Influence: Communicate complex findings and recommendations clearly and persuasively to stakeholders at all levels. Create impactful presentations and facilitate meetings to drive consensus and decision-making.
Continuous Improvement & Documentation: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce manual effort and improve data quality. Ensure all phases of project, program and process development are documented and disseminated to the relevant functional areas.

7–10 years of experience in material management, procurement, sourcing, program management or analytics within a matrixed or global organization.
Demonstrated ability to interpret supplier and product data and translate findings into actionable supplier, sourcing and engineering outcomes.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data visualization) and PowerPoint (presentation design and storytelling); experience with Databricks, Tableau, Power BI or SQL preferred.
Professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Six Sigma) are a plus.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to influence and build relationships across diverse teams and geographies.
Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking and stakeholder management abilities.
Familiarity with product or environmental regulatory requirements is an advantage but not required; the right supply chain professional will be developed on the regulatory detail.

This role is pivotal in keeping Applied's products compliant and its supply base able to supply them. Your analysis, and the actions you drive from it, will directly influence sourcing decisions, product change and the company's regulatory standing.

jobs.description:

As a market leader, we aim to create value by offering cutting-edge solutions. We are committed to ensuring that our customers receive the best and most cost-effective performance from our products and services and that our patients receive the best quality of care. In today's competitive and ever-changing markets, it is the added value we offer our customers that makes the vital difference.

ES10061-ESPANA AL AIR LIQUIDE ESPAÑA, S.A.

Garantizar la entrega integral del portfolio de proyectos operativos en plazo, coste y calidad, velando por el cumplimiento estricto de las normas de Seguridad, Calidad e IMS, así como liderar la mejora continua de procesos y la gestión del cambio para asegurar la máxima adopción y formación de los equipos operativos y coordinar la interlocución interdepartamental y analizar los KPIs para corregir tempranamente cualquier desviación operativa de los proyectos.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Gestión del Portfolio de Proyectos:

Supervisar de forma integral el portfolio de proyectos del área asignada, controlando plazos, costes y calidad para garantizar su entrega conforme a los objetivos fijados. Asimismo, recopilar y consolidar periódicamente los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) —tales como cumplimiento de planes, SLAs, niveles de servicio, tiempos de parada, costes operacionales o TCO, entre otros— para construir un cuadro de mando unificado de la actividad. A partir de este análisis, identificar tempranamente cualquier desviación respecto a las metas marcadas, realizar diagnósticos de causa raíz y proponer a la Dirección planes de acción correctivos adaptados a cada ámbito o ámbito geográfico según aplique.

Liderar y gestionar proyectos
Definir el alcance, el cronograma de hitos, la asignación de recursos y los entregables clave para iniciativas operativas (Ejemplos: Apertura de nuevas instalaciones, implantación de nuevos flujos de trabajo, cambio de software de gestión y reestructuraciones logísticas)
Optimización y Mejora Continua de Procesos: Análisis y mapeo de procesos (Workflow Mapping) identificando cuellos de botella, ineficiencias, pérdidas de tiempo y oportunidades de reducción de costes, aplicando metodologías de mejora continua (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) para diseñar o simplificar procedimientos operativos en el área o actividad y liderar la implantación. Ejemplo: Estandarización en la Gestión de Subcontratas
Gestión del Cambio (Change Management): Liderar la estrategia de transición para asegurar que los equipos (Ejemp: Equipos de plantas, almacenes o departamentos) adopten los nuevos procesos o herramientas digitales, garantizando la continuidad del negocio, lo que implica:

Definición y ejecución de una estrategia de Comunicación

Involucrar a los managers como patrocinadores del cambio.

Diseñar planes de formación para asegurar que todo el personal adquiera las competencias requeridas para la nueva operativa.

Identificar tempranamente las resistencias (miedo a la tecnología, pérdida de control, sobrecarga de trabajo) y aplicar medidas correctoras.

Monitorizar la tasa de adopción real tras la implantación y realizando ajustes para evitar que se vuelva atrás.

Coordinación Interdepartamental
Actuar como interlocutor único entre áreas, departamentos, regiones, etc para alinear directrices, homogeneizar criterios operativos y eliminar discrepancias procedimentales.
Analizar la carga de trabajo agregada de los equipos para balancear recursos y gestionar picos
Interlocución con otras áreas o departamentos como por ejemplo:

Compras: Definición y seguimiento técnico de acuerdos marco globales con contratas y proveedores.

Ventas: Arbitraje de prioridades entre proyectos comerciales y operaciones.

Ingeniería: Traslado del feedback operativo del campo hacia Ingeniería para mejorar los estándares de diseño.

Seguridad (HSEQ): Traducir normativas, alertas y planes de prevención en instrucciones operativas uniformes.

Detección de Desviaciones y Planes de Acción:

Supervisar analíticamente los desvíos respecto a los objetivos marcados, realizando diagnósticos de causa raíz y proponiendo planes de acción correctivos globales o específicos

Seguridad, Calidad e IMS (Sistema de Gestión Integrado)

Garantizar el cumplimiento estricto y coordinado de la normativa interna, externa y del sistema de gestión integrada (IMS) de Seguridad, Salud, Calidad y Medio Ambiente en las operaciones.

Centralizar el reporte de desviaciones, incidentes o cuasi accidentes en los proyectos; colaborar en el análisis de causa raíz y liderar el despliegue global de las acciones preventivas y correctivas necesarias para evitar su reincidencia.

Soporte centralizado en auditorías: Coordinar la preparación de evidencias, dar soporte a las auditorías del sistema IMS y asegurar el seguimiento eficaz de los planes de acción resultantes.

"Infrastructure + LIFE + Innovation"

■Background
The company is a listed AI company providing AI and mathematical optimization solutions mainly in the social infrastructure field. With rapidly growing demand for AI projects centered on social infrastructure, the company is strengthening hiring for the most upstream position that leads business issues to solutions through technology (AI Project Manager). It seeks people with experience in requirements definition and design of large-scale systems and the ability to bridge customer operations and IT to further expand the business.

■Job Description
As a project manager, you will structure clients' business issues and design solutions using AI and mathematical optimization, then lead AI projects in social infrastructure fields (energy, manufacturing, logistics, etc.) from concept to execution.
・Issue organization and concept: organizing and structuring issues and requirements through interviews from executives to frontline staff; building solution hypotheses and gaining agreement

・Logistics: improving delivery efficiency and reducing environmental impact by optimizing transport planning

Engineering departments are divided by domain (power, production, ship allocation, urban transportation), and assignment will be based on your preferences and aptitude. Projects are led by AI project managers with diverse professionals such as sales, AI consultants, AI architects, data scientists, SEs and infrastructure domain experts (about 1 PM and 1–2 engineers in the PoC phase; about 2 PMs and 3–6 engineers in full development). After the PoC, projects move to the application development phase in close collaboration with the application team.

・Professional growth: acquire cutting-edge data science expertise and gain new insights through collaboration with diverse industries
・Large discretion: your proposals and actions directly connect to the company and business
・Social contribution: feel a strong sense of contribution through a business that advances infrastructure

■Career Plan
・Short term: participate in projects worth tens of millions to hundreds of millions of yen as an AI development PM (business architect), learning AI-specific requirements definition and social implementation know-how
・Mid term: become a general PM leading projects worth hundreds of millions of yen, managing multiple projects and teams
・Long term: business head, CxO candidate such as VPoE/CTO, or evangelist in a specific technology area

*Office attendance of about 1–2 days a week may be required depending on the project
・Probation period: 6 months (no change in conditions)

- Experience in system planning, requirements definition and architecture study as an IT consultant

Support operational decision-making through high-quality intelligence products and insights
Permanent, full-time opportunity based in Auckland or Christchurch

About The Role   Mō tēnei Tūranga Mahi

As a Senior Intelligence Analyst, you'll lead the analysis and assessment of intelligence that helps Customs identify threats, manage risks and make informed operational decisions to protect New Zealand's border.

Working within Customs' Intelligence and Investigations Group, you'll lead analytical work across tactical and operational intelligence environments. You'll transform complex information from multiple sources into actionable intelligence products, helping operational teams identify threats, disrupt criminal activity and target resources effectively.

You'll provide intelligence insights and assessments that influence operational activity, support risk-based decision-making and contribute to Customs' understanding of emerging threats.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work on a diverse range of intelligence matters while collaborating with partners across government agencies and international networks.

As a senior member of the team, you'll provide coaching and technical guidance to analysts, contribute to capability development, and support team leadership when required.

This permanent role can be based in Auckland or Christchurch and reports to the Supervising Customs Officer. The salary range for this position is $83,889 - $107,897.

About You I Ko Wai Koe

You're an experienced intelligence professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning information into meaningful insights.

You're naturally curious and analytical, with the ability to identify patterns, trends and emerging risks within complex information. You can work confidently in dynamic operational environments and communicate your findings clearly to a range of audiences.

To Be Successful In This Role, You'll Bring

Experience working in an intelligence, investigative, risk, compliance or law enforcement environment
Strong analytical skills and experience applying intelligence methodologies and risk assessment frameworks
Experience producing high-quality intelligence reports, assessments and recommendations
The ability to interpret and analyse information from multiple sources to identify risks, inform operational activity and support enforcement outcomes.
Experience working with large datasets and analytical tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Nexus or similar platforms
Knowledge of information security requirements, including handling classified and sensitive information
Strong relationship management skills and the ability to work effectively across agencies and stakeholder groups
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting intelligence findings and briefings
A collaborative approach, with the ability to coach and support less experienced team members

Knowledge of the border, law enforcement or national security environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Working at Customs I Mahi ki te Mana Ārai o Aotearoa

Our people get on-the-job training, formal courses and leadership programmes and the chance to move across diverse roles. We foster an inclusive and supportive team environment with vibrant social clubs and cultural groups. We also support flexible working - talk to us about how we can help you achieve your flexible working goals, within our operational requirements.  Our people get discounted health insurance, and three days of service holidays in addition to four weeks of annual leave.

Requirements to Join Customs | Ngā Whakaritenga uru mai

This role requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret national security clearance
.

To be eligible, you must be a New Zealand Citizen or Permanent Resident and meet the Government's security clearance requirements. This includes an assessment of your residency history, background and personal circumstances. Already having Top Secret clearance is a benefit, but not a requirement.

You Must Also

Have a background that can be verified as part of the security clearance process
Pass a police check, medical assessment and drug test
Hold a full New Zealand Driver Licence

Applicants will typically have lived in New Zealand for the last 10 years. Extended periods overseas of more than 6 months may affect eligibility, although time spent in Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom or the United States can often be accommodated as part of the clearance assessment.

How To Apply I Me Pehea Te Whakauru

jobs.title: Research & Development (R&D) Specialist Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Overview

University Hospital Southampton is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us

Job Title: Research & Development (R&D) Specialist Data Analyst

Contract Type: Permanent

Please be advised that this vacancy may close earlier than stated if we receive a large number of applications.

Main duties of the job

This is an exciting opportunity to join our growing Data & AI team within the Research & Development department at University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust, as a Senior Research Analyst.

Working within the Southampton Emerging Therapies and Technologies (SETT) Centre, you will combine advanced analytical and data engineering expertise with line management responsibilities, leading a group of analysts and data engineers to deliver high-quality research data projects.

Our team supports clinical and academic research through the extraction, processing and analysis of routinely collected healthcare data, developing innovative tools and infrastructure to expand research capacity and improve patient outcomes.

You will play an important role in supporting research project delivery, ensuring technical quality, and working in the team to improve team processes and capabilities.

The SETT Data & AI team works to drive future transformation in patient care through the streamlined extraction of high quality data at scale, and the application of state of the art analytical techniques to drive research. By developing a data landscape friendly to research, we aim to expand Trust-wide research capacity and improve patient outcomes through helping to shape the future of medicine. This is a creative and rapidly evolving unit within the hospital’s R&D environment, and successful candidates will have the exciting opportunity to help shape its direction and long-term aims.

Working for our organisation

As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated ‘Good’ by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care.

We support flexible working and will consider requests taking into account the needs of the service. UHS employees are able to access a range of NHS discounts, are entitled to a minimum of 35 days paid holiday (pro rata), and we offer a generous pension scheme.

Southampton is an attractive place to live and work situated on the south coast, with an international airport and direct trains to London. The New Forest National Park and beaches of the Jurassic coast are also right on our doorstep. The city offers living costs 30% lower than London and 17 schools rated outstanding by Ofsted.

We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. Relying too heavily on generic, AI-generated content instead of drawing from your own strengths and accomplishments may lead to your application being rejected if multiple candidates present identical or similar information.

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the delivery of complex research data analysis projects within the Data & AI team. You will support project development and delivery, maintain high technical standards, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the team's capabilities and working practices.

The Data & AI team works closely with clinical and academic researchers across University Hospital Southampton and partner organisations, supporting a diverse portfolio of research projects using routinely collected healthcare data. Our work ranges from developing automated data extraction and transformation pipelines to undertaking advanced analytical studies, building innovative research tools and improving the infrastructure that enables research at scale. Through this work, we aim to expand research capacity, support scientific discovery and ultimately improve patient outcomes.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Research project development and delivery: Develop and manage a pipeline of research data projects, guiding enquiries from initial Expression of Interest through feasibility assessment, scoping, resource estimation and prioritisation into active delivery. Support the analytical delivery of allocated projects, monitoring progress, and working closely with researchers and research delivery teams to ensure projects meet their scientific and technical requirements.
Technical and analytical leadership: Undertake complex analyses of routinely collected NHS healthcare data, alongside the design and development of robust, reproducible data extraction, transformation and processing pipelines across clinical information systems. Provide technical oversight, including code review, testing, validation and documentation, while supporting the adoption of consistent technical standards and high-quality development practices.
Infrastructure, governance and service development: Contribute to the design and improvement of research data infrastructure, analytical tooling, development environments and automation capabilities to enable efficient and scalable study delivery. Help develop and embed team processes, policies and technical standards through knowledge-sharing, ensuring appropriate information governance and research compliance.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a motivated and experienced analyst with an interest in advancing healthcare research.

The following skills and experience would position you well for this role:

Advanced analytical and engineering expertise: Educated to degree level in a numerate or scientific discipline, alongside substantial professional experience in data analysis or data engineering with strong SQL and Python skills, experience working with complex datasets, and a sound understanding of reproducible data processing, software development and quality assurance.
Project delivery and client-facing experience: Demonstrable experience of coordinating and delivering complex analytical or engineering projects in a client-facing environment, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders, understand requirements, assess feasibility, agree deliverables, manage expectations and communicate progress, supported by strong interpersonal, communication and relationship-management skills.
Technical judgement and continuous improvement: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, experience of handling sensitive information, an understanding of data protection and quality assurance requirements, and the ability to independently resolve technical challenges, improve working practices and support colleagues through knowledge-sharing and mentoring.

Person specification

Qualifications

Essential criteria

Educated to degree level or able to demonstrate equivalent level of knowledge/research experience relevant to the role.

Knowledge and Experience

Essential criteria

Significant experience of working with SQL to directly interrogate organisational data
Experienced use of Python programming in a working environment for engineering, data science or research
Experience of working with complex data across multiple disparate databases and multi-user environments, being able to demonstrate knowledge of these databases/ software.
Experience of medical research methodology and statutory clinical trial regulations, GCP and research governance requirements.
Experience of clinical trials in the NHS or the commercial health research sector.
Evidence of continuing professional development.
Evidence of ongoing/current Good Clinical Practice Training (GCP)
Thorough understanding of the systems and processes which are used to support the delivery of high quality clinical care in a research environment.
An understanding of R&D issues in the NHS.
Knowledge of research governance and quality assurance systems to ensure safe systems for patients.
Experience of previous training in monitoring of clinical research studies.
Knowledge of data governance requirements including GDPR

Desirable criteria

Commercial research experience.
Previous experience in using IRAS for R&D applications
Experience of working with additional programming languages
Experience of applying machine learning/LLMs within data engineering pipelines
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD development
Ability to work in multi-disciplinary teams, working with technical and non-technical persons
Experience of working collaboratively with version control tools such as Git

Trust Values

Essential criteria

Patients First
Always Improving
Working Together

Converting legacy industrial and energy sites into modern data-centre facilities, Era4 is combining brownfield regeneration opportunities with cleaner, efficient, scalable compute capacity for healthcare, research, finance, enterprise, and public-sector organisations.

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to join our fast-scaling team. In this role, you will deliver projects across our technology and infrastructure teams as we grow from one site to several. You will work with engineers to turn technical plans into clear delivery plans, keep several connected work streams moving, and support the PMO by keeping our projects in one clear view. This is an opportunity to join a mission-led AI business redefining infrastructure, intelligence, and impact for enterprise customers.

Delivery

Key Responsibilities:

Run technology projects across infrastructure, network, systems and internal tools.
Work with engineers to translate technical designs into plans with clear steps, owners, dates and dependencies.
Keep several connected workstreams moving in parallel, and understand how a delay in one affects the others.
Roll out changes in stages, with a test group first, a rollback plan if needed, and support after go-live.
Clear blockers and drive issues to resolution, rather than simply passing them on.
Hold suppliers and contractors to their commitments.

PMO & Delivery Control

Own and maintain project plans, RAID logs, dependencies, decisions and actions, ensuring information reflects the real delivery position rather than simply recording updates.
Maintain a single, accurate view of the technology project portfolio, showing priorities, milestones, dependencies, resource constraints, paused activity and the reasons behind changes.
Produce clear weekly delivery reporting highlighting progress against milestones, key risks, decisions required, emerging blockers and areas requiring escalation.
Track cross-project dependencies and critical-path activity, identifying where delays in one team, supplier or technical workstream could impact wider delivery.
Identify recurring delivery issues and process gaps, working with teams to improve planning, handovers, tooling and ways of working rather than repeatedly managing the same problems.
Drive actions through to closure, challenging missed commitments and ensuring owners, deadlines and next steps remain clear.

Stakeholder & Delivery Coordination

Act as the delivery link across technology, operations, engineering teams, suppliers and project stakeholders, ensuring dependencies and responsibilities are understood and actively managed.
Translate complex technical activity into clear delivery impacts, enabling non-technical stakeholders to understand progress, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
Build enough understanding of each technical workstream to challenge status updates and distinguish genuine milestone progress from activity, rather than simply accepting percentage-complete reporting.
Identify delivery slippage before deadlines are missed, escalating risks early and working with technical owners to establish recovery actions.
Coordinate internal teams and external suppliers around key milestones, handovers, installations, testing and operational readiness, ensuring projects move cleanly from delivery into BAU operations.

Essential Experience

Proven experience delivering or coordinating technical infrastructure projects, ideally across data centres, cloud, networking, security or hardware deployment.
Able to engage confidently with engineers, understand technical dependencies, challenge blockers and turn technical activity into clear delivery plans.
Experienced in managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, coordinating dependencies across internal technical teams.
Comfortable managing suppliers, contractors and third parties, holding them accountable for milestones, deliverables and issues.
Proven ownership of project plans, RAID logs, dependencies, actions and reporting, ensuring risks are identified early and actions are driven through to completion.
Highly organised and comfortable bringing structure and pace to complex technical delivery without over-engineering the process.

One Or More Would Be An Advantage

Experience in a fast-growing technology, cloud, infrastructure or AI company.
Some understanding of data centre basics: power, cooling and networking.
Experience using data, automation or AI to reduce manual status chasing.
Agile, Waterfall or a mix of both. GPU experience is not required.

You’ll be joining a mission-driven start-up building critical national infrastructure, where operational excellence directly enables growth. This role offers high visibility with leadership, real autonomy, and the chance to shape how a next-generation company operates at scale.

Job Description:

PROGRAM SR MANAGER

The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary management representative for the EFAST2 program and is accountable for the leadership, direction, coordination, and successful execution of all contract activities. This role leads a complex Federal IT program across functional and organizational boundaries, ensuring that Government and contractor objectives are achieved through disciplined program governance, strong customer partnership, and effective management of performance, quality, schedule, budget, staffing, and subcontractors.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Delivery

Provide overall leadership, direction, and day-to-day management for the EFAST2 contract, establishing priorities, execution strategies, governance, and performance expectations.
Lead multidisciplinary systems development, operations, and contact center teams of 30 or more technical and administrative staff across multiple locations, including subordinate managers, specialized subcontractors, and consultants.
Direct staff and task activities to meet contractual requirements and Government and contractor objectives, while promoting collaboration across matrixed functions and organizations.
Manage program risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and corrective actions to sustain delivery of high-quality outcomes on schedule and within budget.
Oversee delivery in a cloud-based environment using Agile, hybrid Agile, and traditional project management approaches as appropriate.

Government and Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as the primary liaison with the Department of Labor Contracting Officer’s Representative and Program Manager, coordinating activities, negotiating tasks and priorities, and resolving program-level issues.
Build trusted relationships with Federal leadership, customers, and stakeholders to understand and anticipate needs and translate them into actionable product, program, and delivery requirements.
Prepare and deliver clear written communications, status reports, executive briefings, and presentations to all levels of Government management for planning, decision-making, and control of contract activities.
Interpret and apply Federal Government policies, requirements, regulations, acquisition practices, and compliance obligations to program execution.

Contract Performance, Quality, and Compliance

Ensure compliance with contract requirements, performance standards, service-level commitments, governance processes, and applicable Federal policies and procedures.
Assure the quality of products, services, and deliverables through quality management processes, reviews, audits, inspections, and site visits.
Establish and monitor performance metrics, provide transparent reporting, and implement corrective and continuous-improvement actions when needed.
Maintain accountability for contract deliverables, staffing, resources, and successful execution within approved schedule and cost constraints.

Financial, Resource, and Subcontractor Management

Manage program budgets of comparable size and complexity, including forecasts, resource plans, financial reporting, and controls that maintain expenditures within the allotted contract ceiling.
Plan and monitor staffing and resource utilization to ensure the right technical, operational, and administrative capabilities are available to meet program needs.
Coordinate and monitor subcontractor, consultant, and vendor activities, performance, schedules, quality, and deliverables.
Ensure effective communication, integration, and accountability across all contract participants and external partners.

Required Qualifications

Education and Certifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or another field related to the contract requirements.
Project Management Institute Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
Project Management Institute Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) certification or equivalent.

Experience

At least 15 years of experience managing IT projects or programs of similar complexity and size.
At least 10 years of experience managing projects or programs with 30 or more personnel, including specialized subcontractors and consultants.
At least 10 years of experience collaborating with customers and stakeholders to understand and anticipate needs and translate them into product and program requirements.
At least 10 years of experience managing budgets of similar size and complexity while remaining within the allotted ceiling amount.
Demonstrated success managing, coordinating, and sustaining Federal IT programs of similar complexity and scale on schedule and within budget.
Demonstrated success organizing, planning, directing, and coordinating geographically dispersed systems development, operations, and contact center teams comprising 30 or more technical staff, subcontractors, and consultants.
Demonstrated success managing programs of similar complexity and size in a cloud-based environment.
Demonstrated success producing effective oral and written communications and presenting to all levels of Government management.
Demonstrated success interpreting and operationalizing Federal Government policies and requirements.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Expert knowledge of Federal IT program management, governance, acquisition, risk, quality, and compliance practices.
Executive-level leadership, organizational, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead large, geographically dispersed, multidisciplinary teams in a matrixed, mission-critical environment.
Ability to balance changing priorities while maintaining accountability for customer outcomes, quality, schedule, budget, and contract performance.
Strong command of Agile, hybrid Agile, and traditional delivery methodologies, with the judgment to apply the appropriate approach.

To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

lead and develop Council’s information security governance, risk, compliance and assurance capability
maintain an effective security policy and governance framework aligned with recognised standards

provide clear, timely reporting on Council’s security posture, risks, compliance and assurance

translate complex security matters into clear business impacts and priorities for senior leaders and governance groups.

a recognised industry certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or CISA

experience managing external auditors, assessors and specialist security providers
excellent report-writing, influencing and communication skills

Applied Materials is seeking an experienced Compliance Project Manager. The role will be at the Austin office and is onsite (not remote or hybrid).

Role Overview

As a key member of the Strategy Office, you will own how the Global Supply Chain responds to product and environmental regulatory requirements — surveying the supply base, interpreting what the results mean for Applied's products, and driving the sourcing and engineering actions that follow. This role suits a supply chain professional who can read a complex data set and determine what to do about it: someone who turns supplier survey results into prioritized supplier, sourcing and engineering actions, and carries those actions to closure across a matrixed global organization.

Must have supply chain, procurement or sourcing experience.
Must have strong data analysis and reporting skills.
Must have experience influencing and presenting data to executive level.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Base Survey & Data Management: Own the supply base survey process — determine which suppliers, parts and materials to survey and to what level of detail, drive collection across the supply base, and hold suppliers accountable for complete, accurate and timely responses.
Analytics & Reporting: Analyze large and complex supplier and product data sets using advanced analytics tools (Excel, Databricks, Tableau etc.) to identify exposure, risk and gaps. Develop the reporting that drives compliance and cost initiatives and informs sourcing decisions.
Action Translation & Execution: Convert survey findings into prioritized supplier, sourcing and engineering actions — coordinating part changes, supplier requirements and engineering change with Supplier Account Management, Supplier Engineering, the Design Engineering Authority and the Business Unit materials through implementation.
Regulatory Compliance: Serve as the Global Supply Chain point of contact for product and environmental regulatory requirements, including US-EPA/TSCA and EU/REACH, partnering with the Compliance Legal team on formal interpretation and with EHS as needed.
Project Management: Lead and manage multiple compliance projects and programs simultaneously, applying best-in-class methodologies to ensure successful delivery of outcomes, milestones and resource allocation.
Communication & Influence: Communicate complex findings and recommendations clearly and persuasively to stakeholders at all levels. Create impactful presentations and facilitate meetings to drive consensus and decision-making.
Continuous Improvement & Documentation: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce manual effort and improve data quality. Ensure all phases of project, program and process development are documented and disseminated to the relevant functional areas.

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
7–10 years of experience in material management, procurement, sourcing, program management or analytics within a matrixed or global organization.
Demonstrated ability to interpret supplier and product data and translate findings into actionable supplier, sourcing and engineering outcomes.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data visualization) and PowerPoint (presentation design and storytelling); experience with Databricks, Tableau, Power BI or SQL preferred.
Professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Six Sigma) are a plus.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to influence and build relationships across diverse teams and geographies.
Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking and stakeholder management abilities.
Familiarity with product or environmental regulatory requirements is an advantage but not required; the right supply chain professional will be developed on the regulatory detail.

This role is pivotal in keeping Applied's products compliant and its supply base able to supply them. Your analysis, and the actions you drive from it, will directly influence sourcing decisions, product change and the company's regulatory standing.

In today's competitive and ever-changing markets, it is the added value we offer our customers that makes the vital difference.

ES10061-ESPANA AL AIR LIQUIDE ESPAÑA, S.A.

Garantizar la entrega integral del portfolio de proyectos operativos en plazo, coste y calidad, velando por el cumplimiento estricto de las normas de Seguridad, Calidad e IMS, así como liderar la mejora continua de procesos y la gestión del cambio para asegurar la máxima adopción y formación de los equipos operativos y coordinar la interlocución interdepartamental y analizar los KPIs para corregir tempranamente cualquier desviación operativa de los proyectos.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Gestión del Portfolio de Proyectos:

Supervisar de forma integral el portfolio de proyectos del área asignada, controlando plazos, costes y calidad para garantizar su entrega conforme a los objetivos fijados. Asimismo, recopilar y consolidar periódicamente los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) —tales como cumplimiento de planes, SLAs, niveles de servicio, tiempos de parada, costes operacionales o TCO, entre otros— para construir un cuadro de mando unificado de la actividad. A partir de este análisis, identificar tempranamente cualquier desviación respecto a las metas marcadas, realizar diagnósticos de causa raíz y proponer a la Dirección planes de acción correctivos adaptados a cada ámbito o ámbito geográfico según aplique.

Liderar y gestionar proyectos
Definir el alcance, el cronograma de hitos, la asignación de recursos y los entregables clave para iniciativas operativas (Ejemplos: Apertura de nuevas instalaciones, implantación de nuevos flujos de trabajo, cambio de software de gestión y reestructuraciones logísticas)
Optimización y Mejora Continua de Procesos: Análisis y mapeo de procesos (Workflow Mapping) identificando cuellos de botella, ineficiencias, pérdidas de tiempo y oportunidades de reducción de costes, aplicando metodologías de mejora continua (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) para diseñar o simplificar procedimientos operativos en el área o actividad y liderar la implantación. Ejemplo: Estandarización en la Gestión de Subcontratas
Gestión del Cambio (Change Management): Liderar la estrategia de transición para asegurar que los equipos (Ejemp: Equipos de plantas, almacenes o departamentos) adopten los nuevos procesos o herramientas digitales, garantizando la continuidad del negocio, lo que implica:

Definición y ejecución de una estrategia de Comunicación

Involucrar a los managers como patrocinadores del cambio.

Diseñar planes de formación para asegurar que todo el personal adquiera las competencias requeridas para la nueva operativa.

Identificar tempranamente las resistencias (miedo a la tecnología, pérdida de control, sobrecarga de trabajo) y aplicar medidas correctoras.

Monitorizar la tasa de adopción real tras la implantación y realizando ajustes para evitar que se vuelva atrás.

Coordinación Interdepartamental
Actuar como interlocutor único entre áreas, departamentos, regiones, etc para alinear directrices, homogeneizar criterios operativos y eliminar discrepancias procedimentales.
Analizar la carga de trabajo agregada de los equipos para balancear recursos y gestionar picos
Interlocución con otras áreas o departamentos como por ejemplo:

Compras: Definición y seguimiento técnico de acuerdos marco globales con contratas y proveedores.

Ventas: Arbitraje de prioridades entre proyectos comerciales y operaciones.

Ingeniería: Traslado del feedback operativo del campo hacia Ingeniería para mejorar los estándares de diseño.

Seguridad (HSEQ): Traducir normativas, alertas y planes de prevención en instrucciones operativas uniformes.

Detección de Desviaciones y Planes de Acción:

Supervisar analíticamente los desvíos respecto a los objetivos marcados, realizando diagnósticos de causa raíz y proponiendo planes de acción correctivos globales o específicos

Seguridad, Calidad e IMS (Sistema de Gestión Integrado)

Garantizar el cumplimiento estricto y coordinado de la normativa interna, externa y del sistema de gestión integrada (IMS) de Seguridad, Salud, Calidad y Medio Ambiente en las operaciones.

Centralizar el reporte de desviaciones, incidentes o cuasi accidentes en los proyectos; colaborar en el análisis de causa raíz y liderar el despliegue global de las acciones preventivas y correctivas necesarias para evitar su reincidencia.

Soporte centralizado en auditorías: Coordinar la preparación de evidencias, dar soporte a las auditorías del sistema IMS y asegurar el seguimiento eficaz de los planes de acción resultantes.

Experiencia en Gestión de Proyectos

Experience producing high-quality intelligence reports, assessments and recommendations

Job Overview

University Hospital Southampton is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us

Job Title: Research & Development (R&D) Specialist Data Analyst

Contract Type: Permanent

Please be advised that this vacancy may close earlier than stated if we receive a large number of applications.

Main duties of the job

This is an exciting opportunity to join our growing Data & AI team within the Research & Development department at University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust, as a Senior Research Analyst.

Working within the Southampton Emerging Therapies and Technologies (SETT) Centre, you will combine advanced analytical and data engineering expertise with line management responsibilities, leading a group of analysts and data engineers to deliver high-quality research data projects.

Our team supports clinical and academic research through the extraction, processing and analysis of routinely collected healthcare data, developing innovative tools and infrastructure to expand research capacity and improve patient outcomes.

You will play an important role in supporting research project delivery, ensuring technical quality, and working in the team to improve team processes and capabilities.

The SETT Data & AI team works to drive future transformation in patient care through the streamlined extraction of high quality data at scale, and the application of state of the art analytical techniques to drive research. By developing a data landscape friendly to research, we aim to expand Trust-wide research capacity and improve patient outcomes through helping to shape the future of medicine. This is a creative and rapidly evolving unit within the hospital’s R&D environment, and successful candidates will have the exciting opportunity to help shape its direction and long-term aims.

Working for our organisation

As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated ‘Good’ by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care.

We support flexible working and will consider requests taking into account the needs of the service. UHS employees are able to access a range of NHS discounts, are entitled to a minimum of 35 days paid holiday (pro rata), and we offer a generous pension scheme.

Southampton is an attractive place to live and work situated on the south coast, with an international airport and direct trains to London. The New Forest National Park and beaches of the Jurassic coast are also right on our doorstep. The city offers living costs 30% lower than London and 17 schools rated outstanding by Ofsted.

We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. Relying too heavily on generic, AI-generated content instead of drawing from your own strengths and accomplishments may lead to your application being rejected if multiple candidates present identical or similar information.

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the delivery of complex research data analysis projects within the Data & AI team. You will support project development and delivery, maintain high technical standards, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the team's capabilities and working practices.

The Data & AI team works closely with clinical and academic researchers across University Hospital Southampton and partner organisations, supporting a diverse portfolio of research projects using routinely collected healthcare data. Our work ranges from developing automated data extraction and transformation pipelines to undertaking advanced analytical studies, building innovative research tools and improving the infrastructure that enables research at scale. Through this work, we aim to expand research capacity, support scientific discovery and ultimately improve patient outcomes.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Run technology projects across infrastructure, network, systems and internal tools.
Work with engineers to translate technical designs into plans with clear steps, owners, dates and dependencies.
Keep several connected workstreams moving in parallel, and understand how a delay in one affects the others.
Roll out changes in stages, with a test group first, a rollback plan if needed, and support after go-live.
Clear blockers and drive issues to resolution, rather than simply passing them on.
Hold suppliers and contractors to their commitments.

PMO & Delivery Control

Own and maintain project plans, RAID logs, dependencies, decisions and actions, ensuring information reflects the real delivery position rather than simply recording updates.
Maintain a single, accurate view of the technology project portfolio, showing priorities, milestones, dependencies, resource constraints, paused activity and the reasons behind changes.
Produce clear weekly delivery reporting highlighting progress against milestones, key risks, decisions required, emerging blockers and areas requiring escalation.
Track cross-project dependencies and critical-path activity, identifying where delays in one team, supplier or technical workstream could impact wider delivery.
Identify recurring delivery issues and process gaps, working with teams to improve planning, handovers, tooling and ways of working rather than repeatedly managing the same problems.
Drive actions through to closure, challenging missed commitments and ensuring owners, deadlines and next steps remain clear.

Stakeholder & Delivery Coordination

Act as the delivery link across technology, operations, engineering teams, suppliers and project stakeholders, ensuring dependencies and responsibilities are understood and actively managed.
Translate complex technical activity into clear delivery impacts, enabling non-technical stakeholders to understand progress, risks, dependencies and decisions required.

Experienced in managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, coordinating dependencies across internal technical teams.
Comfortable managing suppliers, contractors and third parties, holding them accountable for milestones, deliverables and issues.
